activities.emptyBody: Stage changes, meetings and notes appear here automatically.
activities.hint: This log is append-only: an entry cannot be edited or deleted.
activities.subtitle: Everything that happened, in order.
analytics.avgDaysHint: Measured only on conversions whose creation and conversion dates are both known. An empty sample prints « not measured », never zero.
analytics.subtitle: Where the prospects are and what converts.
campaigns.budgetHint: The budget is declared by the team, not observed as spending. It is never mixed with measured figures.
campaigns.emptyBody: Create a campaign before collecting leads, so every prospect keeps its origin.
campaigns.hint: Every figure below is counted from the leads actually attached to the campaign. Nothing is stored, so nothing can go stale.
campaigns.noCompanies: No company has been created from this campaign yet.
campaigns.noLeads: No lead attached to this campaign yet.
campaigns.rateHint: A rate shown as « not measured » means no lead has been decided yet. It is not zero: a campaign that never ran is not a failed one.
campaigns.subtitle: Where prospects come from, and what each source actually produced.
common.demoBanner: Demonstration data — no real company is stored or contacted.
common.demoReadOnly: Demonstration mode is read-only: nothing is written.
common.name: Name
company.linkHint: Only organizations TRACEFAB is a member of can be linked. Linking assumes access: a link to an invisible organization would show nothing to anyone.
company.noActivityBody: Stage changes and notes appear here.
company.noNextAction: No next contact is scheduled for this company.
company.title: Company
company.whyTargetNote: A qualification entered by the team, not a prediction. It rests only on the fields actually filled in.
connected.emptyBody: Companies appear here as soon as one is created.
connected.whyNotAccessible: Linked, but TRACEFAB is not a member of that organization: row-level security returns nothing. No figure is shown rather than a zero.
contacts.emptyBody: A contact always belongs to a company.
contacts.subtitle: Decision makers and influencers, attached to a company.
customers.emptyWon: No company has been converted yet.
customers.historyNote: Converting a prospect moves nothing: contacts, activities, tasks and meetings stay attached to the same record, so the whole commercial history survives.
customers.subtitle: Won and lost, with the full commercial history.
dashboard.measuredBody: Counted from the records held in the prospect register. When nothing has been decided yet, conversion is shown as not measured rather than as zero.
dashboard.subtitle: Every figure counts real records. Nothing is estimated.
emails.emptyBody: Emails logged on a prospect appear here.
emails.logHint: Record what was sent, to whom, and what happened next. The record is append-only, like the rest of the timeline.
emails.outcomePlaceholder: Sent from your own mailbox. Reply expected, opened, bounced…
emails.refused: TRACEFAB logs emails, it does not send them.
emails.refusedWhy: Sending requires a recorded lawful basis. No consent field exists on a contact yet, so no sending button is offered — this is a decision, not a missing feature.
emails.subject: Subject
emails.subjectRequired: An email log needs a subject.
emails.subtitle: Emails logged by the team — TRACEFAB does not send them.
gate.deniedBody: Your account is authenticated but does not hold an owner or admin role in the TRACEFAB platform organisation. Nothing is displayed rather than showing an empty console that looks like a fault.
gate.signinBody: This console is reserved for the TRACEFAB team. Sign in with an account that belongs to the TRACEFAB platform organisation.
history.emptyBody: Nothing has been recorded for this company yet — no activity, no task, no meeting.
history.sourcesHint: Every record attached to this company, from every source. Tasks are never written to the activity log, so this is the only place where nothing is lost.
history.truncatedWhy: Too many records to serve at once, so the oldest ones are cut. Filter or export to see the rest.
import.hint: Comma or semicolon separated, with a header row. Columns absent from the file stay empty — nothing is invented.
import.mappingHint: Check the suggested mapping. An ignored column is simply not imported.
import.reviewHint: Nothing is written yet. Invalid rows are never written and never auto-corrected: guessing an unreadable value would be inventing data.
import.sourceRequired: A source is required: an imported portfolio without provenance cannot be audited.
import.title: Import prospects
importField.name: Name
leads.collectedHint: The collection date is the date the data was gathered, not the date of import. Left empty, it stays empty: filling it with today would claim a freshness that was never observed.
leads.duplicateFound: This lead already exists. Check the existing record before adding it again.
leads.emptyBody: Leads appear here once they are added by hand or imported.
leads.hint: A lead is not a company. It is a raw acquisition, often incomplete. It becomes a company by promotion, and the promotion keeps its origin.
leads.identityHint: The company name, email or website identifies the lead and prevents duplicates. These three fields cannot be changed afterwards: editing them would let the same prospect be added twice.
leads.provenanceHint: Source and collection date are recorded, never inferred from the file. A prospect without provenance cannot be evaluated.
leads.subtitle: The acquisition queue: prospects that are not companies yet.
lists.deleteConfirm: Delete this list? No company is affected.
lists.label: Prospecting lists
lists.noFilters: Set at least one filter before saving a list.
meetings.emptyBody: Switch the filter, or schedule a meeting.
meetings.hint: Scheduling a meeting does not move the pipeline: those are two separate facts.
meetings.subject: Subject
meetings.subtitle: Scheduled meetings and their outcome.
nav.soonHint: Planned for a later Admin phase — not available yet
notes.appendOnly: A note cannot be edited or deleted once written: the history is a record, not a draft.
notes.detailPlaceholder: Context, names, figures — anything that must not be lost.
notes.emptyBody: Notes written on a prospect appear here.
notes.subtitle: Every note written on a prospect, newest first.
notes.summaryHint: This field is editable and is overwritten each time. For anything that must not change, write a note instead.
notes.summaryRequired: A note needs at least one line.
notes.whatPlaceholder: Call held, decision taken, objection raised…
opportunities.empty: No opportunity can be ranked yet
opportunities.emptyBody: Ranking needs recorded fields: catalogue size, supplier count, country or declared interest. TRACEFAB does not rank what it has not been given.
opportunities.excluded: Excluded from the ranking: %closed already customer or lost, %weak without any recorded signal.
opportunities.howRanked: Ordered by converging signals, then priority, then estimated value. Every conclusion comes from a recorded field — nothing is inferred.
opportunities.subtitle: Ranked by the strength of the recorded signals.
opportunity.declaredNote: Potential and value are declared by the team, not measured.
opportunity.insufficientBody: Nothing recorded supports a conclusion. Fill in catalogue size, supplier count, country or declared interest: TRACEFAB does not guess what it has not been given.
opportunity.noFeature: No feature can be recommended from the recorded fields.
opportunity.noProblem: No problem can be derived from the recorded fields.
opportunityProblem.catalogueUnstructured: Catalogue evidence is probably incomplete or unverified
opportunityProblem.declaredDppInterest: Has declared a high DPP interest
opportunityProblem.declaredTraceabilityI: Has declared a high traceability interest
opportunityProblem.esprScope: Sells into the EU, therefore in scope for the Digital Product Passport
opportunityProblem.largeCatalogue: A catalogue of this size is hard to keep structured
opportunityProblem.manySuppliers: A supplier base of this size cannot be consolidated by hand
opportunityProblem.maturityUnknown: Digital maturity has not been assessed
opportunityProblem.supplierDataManual: Supplier data is very likely assembled manually
pilots.declaredHint: These percentages are declared by the commercial team. They are not measured by TRACEFAB unless the pilot is linked to a real workspace.
pilots.emptyBody: A pilot is created from the company file.
pilots.subtitle: Running pilots, their progression and their results.
pipeline.hint: A stage change is written to the activity log in the same transaction: the pipeline and its history cannot drift apart.
pipeline.subtitle: Move a company from stage to stage. Every move is recorded.
prospects.emptyBody: Add a company or import a list to start working the pipeline.
prospects.subtitle: The whole prospect register, filterable and searchable.
settings.accessNote: Admin access is granted by an active membership with the owner or admin role in the TRACEFAB platform organization. There is no separate switch.
settings.auditNote: Each entry seals the hash of the previous one. A retroactive edit breaks the chain, so an intact chain is evidence the log was not rewritten.
settings.noAuditBody: Entries appear here as soon as a record is created, changed or deleted.
settings.pipelineNote: The only door to change a stage is POST /api/admin/companies/:id/stage, which writes an activity and an audit entry at the same time.
settings.spof: A single active admin is an operational risk: if that account is lost, the console is unreachable.
settings.subtitle: Access, audit trail and platform state.
settings.trailHint: Every mutating action in this console is sealed here.
suppliers.gapHint: The gap is measured minus declared. It shows where the commercial perception and the platform reality diverge — a negative gap means the team overestimated.
suppliers.hint: A measured figure comes from the platform. A declared figure was typed by the team and has not been verified. The two are never mixed.
suppliers.subtitle: Real suppliers of connected accounts, declared counts for the rest.
tasks.emptyBody: Create a task to follow up a prospect, or change the filter.
tasks.hint: A task done late is still late: today includes overdue items.
tasks.subtitle: What must be done, today and late.
usage.emptyBody: Usage appears here once an account is linked to an organization TRACEFAB is a member of.
usage.hiddenCount: %n linked account(s) are hidden here: TRACEFAB is not a member of those organizations, so the platform returns nothing for them.
usage.scope: This is supplier engagement, not application telemetry.
usage.scopeDetail: TRACEFAB produces no application telemetry. Showing any would mean inventing it, so this view reports only what the platform actually records: suppliers onboarded, profile completion, last submission.
usage.subtitle: Real engagement of connected accounts on the platform.
